title: Reliance Industries Ltd — Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
text: Please note that the Company executives will be participating in the Institutional Investors' Meeting - UBS India Summit 2026, scheduled to be held on September 10, 2026 at Mumbai. It is expected that the meeting with the investors will be on one-on-one basis.
